title: Exynos 2700 beats the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Pro in internal testing, insiders say
description: Internal tests of the Exynos 2700 have Samsung LSI buzzing – the chipset outperformed Qualcomm’s Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 (both of them, actually), according to anonymous insiders. First, let’s clear this up – Qualcomm has officially confirmed that there will be two Elite chips in the next generation. They are tentatively being called the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 and 8 Elite Gen 6 Pro. This is separate from the non-Elite Gen 6 chip, by the way. title: Poco F9 series global launch confirmed, design and colors revealed
description: Poco has officially confirmed the global launch of its new F9 series, which will consist of the Poco F9 Pro and F9 Ultra. The company has also revealed the phones’ design and colour options, confirming earlier leaks that the phones are rebranded versions of the Redmi K100 Pro and K100 Pro Max. The Poco F9 Pro and F9 Ultra will be unveiled globally on September 1 via an online event. Apart from confirming the launch date, Poco has also showcased the F9 Ultra in a Dark Cherry colourway, and the F9 Pro in an Aurora Green shade. title: Samsung Galaxy S26 FE: what to expect
description: Samsung’s Galaxy Event August 2026 is this Thursday and will bring the new Galaxy S26 FE. Additionally, we think that Samsung will update its flagship Galaxy Tab S series with two new models. Here is what we know (and think we know) so far. New phone, new Exynos Well, new for the series – the Samsung Galaxy S26 FE will use the Exynos 2500. The S24 FE used a cut-down Exynos 2400e, while the S25 FE used the regular Exynos 2400. We’ve seen the new chipset confirmed by the Google Play Console. We’ve also seen what it can do in early Geekbench scores, but there’s no need to be sneaky...

title: Xiaomi 18 Fold is officially coming in September with the monstrous Xring O3 chipset
description: The next foldable smartphone from Xiaomi is not going to be called Xiaomi Mix Fold 5, but Xiaomi 18 Fold. The company has officially confirmed this. The device is going to be unveiled in September. It will be the first to use Xiaomi's new Xring O3 chipset, the successor to the Xring O1 from last year. The Xring O3 managed to score 5,228,014 points in the AnTuTu V11 benchmark. That's more than any other smartphone SoC today. The SoC features a deca-core CPU with two C1-Ultra cores clocked at up to 4.35GHz, four C1-Premium cores clocked at up to 3.68GHz, and four C1-Pro cores...

description: Lava has added a new device to its portfolio in India today, the Virat V1 Pro 5G. It comes with a 6.75-inch 720x1600 screen with a 120Hz refresh rate, a 50MP main camera, and a 6,000 mAh battery. title: The Honor Play20A has a massive 6.9" display, and a second one on the back
description: The Honor Play20A is a unique model in the company’s lineup, but it may also be a missed opportunity. As you’ve already seen in the thumbnail for this post, the phone has a secondary display on the camera island on its back – something that no other non-folding Honor phone has. This allows you to snap photos with the main camera, which has a… 13MP sensor. And despite appearances, it is the only actual camera on the back. title: Gurman: Early iPhone Ultra testers praise its design, hinge and usability
description: We’re likely just a couple of weeks away from Apple unveiling its first foldable iPhone. Ahead of the launch, a new Bloomberg report has revealed some of the aspects that have impressed early testers of the so-called iPhone Ultra. Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman, citing people who have internally tested the upcoming foldable iPhone, has outlined several aspects of the device that impressed early testers. title: The new Nokia 300 Charge has a dedicated power out button and a 3,700mAh battery
description: The huge battery trend may have started with smartphones, but feature phones are getting in on it too – HMD just announced the Nokia 300 Charge, which has more than double the battery capacity of a typical feature phone. The Charge is equipped with a 3,700mAh battery and a USB-C port. This port can fill up the internal battery at 10W and – at the push of the dedicated “Out” button on the side – can also do 10W reverse charging. description: Recent leaks suggest the Samsung Galaxy S27 Ultra will feature a redesigned rear camera setup with one fewer sensor than the Galaxy S26 Ultra. However, a newly leaked CAD render shows a completely different camera design from those seen in previous leaks. Well-known tipster Ice Universe shared an alleged CAD render of the Galaxy S27 Ultra on X. The render shows an iPhone 17 Pro-like rear camera plateau, with two sensors in separate cutouts and a third camera alongside the flash in a pill-shaped cutout. description: Samsung is set to launch the Galaxy S26 FE later this week and it’s expected to share plenty of similarities with its predecessor. title: Weekly poll: would you buy the Honor Robot Phone and why?
description: After months of teasers and red carpet events, the Honor Robot Phone is finally official and it is now available in stores – only in China, but you didn’t want one anyway, right? description: Last week, we asked you which Pixel 11 model you would buy and now the results are in. description: About two weeks ago, Zack from YouTube channel JerryRigEverything subjected the Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8 to a durability test. Now, he’s put the Google Pixel 11 Pro Fold through one too.
